answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, which mirror honest agent behaviors while hiding identities. By integrating verifiable delay functions, akin to a lantern guiding authentication, we establish an information-theoretic defense against identity cloning. The comet of colluding agents attempting to spoof identities is swiftly extinguished by the cryptographic beacon of sequential delay functions, rendering such attacks computationally infeasible and ensuring Byzantine fault tolerance.
